name: mycaisse
description: Track your personal wallet and business cash registers in MyCaisse: balances, spending by category, monthly comparisons, and recording entries.

interface.longDescription:
MyCaisse keeps track of the money in your personal wallet and in the business accounts you run: cash registers, sub-registers, income, expenses and transfers, in each register's own currency.

Connect MyCaisse to ask questions in plain language and get answers from your real data:
- "How much did I spend this month, by category?"
- "What's the balance of each register in my bakery?"
- "Compare deliveries income in September and October."
- "Record a 4,500 DA fuel expense in the Livraisons register."

You choose which accounts the assistant can see when you connect, and whether it may record entries. Totals are always given per currency, never mixed. Internal transfers between your own registers are not counted as spending.

The assistant cannot send or move money. Every action is logged in MyCaisse (My account → AI agents) and you can disconnect it at any time.
capabilities: Spending by category, month or register
defaultPrompt: How much did I spend this month, by category?
What's the balance of each of my registers?
Compare my income in September and October.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the personal wallet @revue and the business account Boulangerie Démo.

positive.prompt: What are the balances of the registers in Boulangerie Démo?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Caisse boutique, its sub-register Livraisons, and Fournisseurs with their balances in DA.

positive.prompt: How much did I spend in October 2026 in my personal wallet, by category?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives October expenses grouped by category (Loyer, Courses, Restaurant…) in DA, and reports the € register separately instead of adding it.

positive.prompt: Compare Boulangerie Démo income in September and October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one income total per month in DA and the difference.

positive.prompt: Record a 4,000 DA fuel expense in the Livraisons register of Boulangerie Démo.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the details, records the expense under Transport / Carburant, and returns the new entry.

negative.prompt: Send 5,000 DA to @karim from my wallet.
Delete all transactions in Caisse boutique.
Add my DA and € balances together into one number.

review.commerce_description: MyCaisse does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT, and this app cannot send or move money.

publication.release_notes: First release: balances, spending summaries, period comparisons and recording entries in MyCaisse.

fr-FR.subtitle: Caisses et budget au quotidien
fr-FR.description:
MyCaisse suit l'argent de votre portefeuille personnel et des comptes pro que vous gérez : caisses, sous-caisses, recettes, dépenses et transferts, chacun dans sa devise.

Connectez MyCaisse pour poser vos questions en langage courant et obtenir des réponses tirées de vos vraies données :
- « Combien j'ai dépensé ce mois-ci, par catégorie ? »
- « Quel est le solde de chaque caisse de ma boulangerie ? »
- « Compare les recettes de livraison de septembre et d'octobre. »
- « Enregistre une dépense de carburant de 4 500 DA dans la caisse Livraisons. »

Vous choisissez à la connexion les comptes visibles et si l'assistant peut enregistrer des saisies. Les totaux sont toujours donnés par devise, jamais mélangés. Les transferts entre vos propres caisses ne comptent pas comme des dépenses.

L'assistant ne peut ni envoyer ni déplacer d'argent. Chaque action est enregistrée dans MyCaisse (Mon compte → Agents IA) et vous pouvez le déconnecter à tout moment.
